# Service Delivery Checklist

This checklist is for service providers, agencies, or operators using this workflow to deliver reports to clients or internal teams.

## Before Starting

- [ ] Confirm client / brand name.
- [ ] Confirm industry category.
- [ ] Confirm competitor accounts.
- [ ] Confirm reporting period.
- [ ] Confirm output format: Markdown / HTML / CSV / PDF / Google Sheets / Notion / Feishu.
- [ ] Confirm whether this is a one-time report or recurring report.

## Data Review

- [ ] Public profile data checked.
- [ ] Recent posts and Reels collected.
- [ ] Hashtags extracted.
- [ ] Creator / brand mentions reviewed.
- [ ] Engagement metrics calculated.
- [ ] Raw data exported.

## Report Writing

- [ ] Executive summary written.
- [ ] Top content ranked.
- [ ] Hashtag trends summarized.
- [ ] Creator mentions documented.
- [ ] Recommendations are specific.
- [ ] No private data included.
- [ ] No unverified partnership claims included.

## Delivery

- [ ] Report exported.
- [ ] Links checked.
- [ ] Formatting checked.
- [ ] Client notes added.
- [ ] Follow-up questions prepared.

## After Delivery

- [ ] Record client feedback.
- [ ] Note recurring questions.
- [ ] Identify possible automation needs.
- [ ] Decide whether client is a fit for weekly monitoring.
